title: Name.com card: the prices our account pays, beside Name.com's public prices

Our markup is $5 of that; the rest is what Name.com charges our account. The Name.com card on Outside services now shows Prices we pay: for each ending we sell, our account's price to register and to renew beside Name.com's public (retail) price and list price, from Name.com's price list (GET /core/v1/tldpricing, live and read only, kept 12 hours, with Ask Name.com again), and a verdict: On retail (our account pays the public price on every ending: ask Name.com about reseller pricing) or Discounted. Nothing is bought or changed.
